message:
Blog slugs now keep the base letter of accented characters, so "Crème brûlée recipes" becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`. `npm test` passes, all 3 tests.

The vendored `slugify` drops any character outside `a-z0-9`, so it was deleting the accented letters. I didn't touch `vendor/`. The fix is in `src/blog/slug.js`, which now strips accents from the title before calling `slugify`.

Shop product URLs (`src/shop/product-url.js`) call the vendored function directly, so they still drop accents. I left them alone because you only asked about blog posts. If you want the same fix there, it needs the same one-line change.
